extension.summary: Unified Kodi metadata & Video Versions updater from local .nfo files, filenames, and TMDbHelper fallback.
extension.description: Metadata Updatarr combines Video Versions management (NFO/filename edition detection, quality badges, duplicate movie grouping, default version swapping, label normalization) with missing metadata recovery (season plots & names, movie plots & taglines) using local .nfo files with TMDbHelper/TMDB fallback. Supports SQLite and MariaDB/MySQL with automatic 3+ backup retention.
